## CHAPTER XXX.

### On the Reign of the Sun.

Now you approach the end of your work, and you have nearly completed your business. Now everything appears like the finest refined gold <note>original: "auri obryzi," referring to gold of the highest purity.</note>, and the <term>virgin's milk</term> <gloss>the white liquid mercury or solvent used in the process</gloss>, with which you soak this matter, becomes intensely yellow. Now return immortal thanks to God, the giver of all good things, who has led the work this far. Pray to Him as a suppliant, that He may guide your counsel from here on, lest by chance you lose everything by attempting to rush the work when it is almost perfected. Consider now that you have waited for nearly seven months, and it would not be sane to annihilate everything in a single hour. Therefore, be very cautious, and all the more so as you are closer to perfection. If you proceed carefully, these notable signs will occur: first, you will observe a certain yellow sweat on the body, and finally yellow vapors as the body settles, tinged with violet and sometimes with a dark purple.
